title: Prachar_AI-AIgnite
summary: A TypeScript hackathon project whose repository incidentally includes a Jupyter notebook (from an unrelated 'gen-ui-for-mmm' project) that generates synthetic mortgage-style tabular data with fields like annual income and property value. The notebook builds an SDV SingleTableMetadata schema and fits SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to sample 10,000 synthetic rows.
needs: The notebook appears to be a stray file from an unrelated project ('gen-ui-for-mmm-main') accidentally committed under Downloads/, not part of the main TypeScript app; relevance to the repo's actual purpose is unclear.
